title: Bicycles by the hundred, and perhaps the unit's deuce-and-a-half, Saigon
description: A tide of parked two-wheelers — bicycles, mopeds, scooters racked side by side down a tree-lined pavement beside a monumental pale stone building — with two olive-drab military trucks at the kerb at left and a uniformed figure walking between them. "This is Saigon. The 2.5 ton truck may be my unit's truck that I drove. The truck is called deuce and a half."
researchNotes: Larry's caption of 2026-09-05 (giscus-vn-0080-c18308110.json). The detail that he drove the unit's 2½-ton truck is new and small and worth keeping — a radio operator with a truck run into Saigon is a duty that morning reports and motor-pool dispatch logs would show. The stone building with arched windows was flagged by the survey as matchable to a Saigon institution and has not been attempted.
